BiblicalUsage: Thirty counts men, years, and silver. David gathered thirty thousand chosen men, Abdon had thirty nephews riding on ass colts, and David reigned seven years in Hebron and thirty and three in Jerusalem. The darkest thirty is the price: thirty pieces of silver, cast to the potter in the house of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe thirty pieces of silver changed what thirty means for ever. A king's reign, an army, a family: all counted in thirties, and then the price of a life, and I hold that no counting is neutral once the cross is in view.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
